candidate_branch_and_worker_transport.transport_policy: Keep the existing single worker checkout and its branch. Once the exact frozen candidate commit is available and the current worker HEAD is freshly read, require worker HEAD to be an ancestor of the final candidate. Create one minimal incremental Git bundle excluding that worker HEAD, transfer only the bundle, fetch it inside the existing repository, and advance with ordinary git merge --ff-only. Re-read branch, status, exact HEAD, and tree after the merge. If the ancestry or cleanliness precondition fails, stop and preserve the current branch; do not create a checkout/branch, switch HEAD, reset, rebase, cherry-pick, or copy an environment.

prepare_check_sequence: Run prepare only after all product, test, resource, manifest, recipe, and required documentation companions are committed and the exact source SHA/tree are read back from the clean attached candidate branch.

Review all 15 actual source pins, complete actual selector collection, all 11 source resource byte rows, candidate primary/supplement proposals, timeout-driver patch, and capsule bindings. Never make the manifest green by hand-editing expected hashes.

If any source-derived primary/supplement/driver bytes must change, commit the exact reviewed proposal as a normal source commit, read back the new SHA/tree, and repeat prepare using the newest supplemental proposal.

When stable, run check against the same exact source SHA/tree, same committed primary manifest, and exact latest proposed supplemental file path+SHA. Require source_preflight_exact, exact actual collection/object binding, capsule bindings current, and zero runner limitations.

Any source, recipe, helper, manifest, or proposal byte change after prepare invalidates affected evidence and requires new source SHA/tree plus prepare/check. The final manifest and all command/tool hashes are read back before launch.

Recipe's prior scratch estimate was about 1.5 GiB with an already-provisioned worker profile, but GCP archive size/platform overhead was unmeasured. Current 4.8 GiB free does not guarantee future sufficiency.

Before each heavy wave, re-read free disk, inode capacity, cgroup memory/events, worker branch cleanliness, and exact package profiles. Do not delete artifacts or install/copy another dependency environment to make capacity appear sufficient.
